notes.title: The Spell Candle Kickstarter is now LIVE!
notes.content: [p]Greetings, oh lovely Monsters![/p][p][/p][p]First of all, we'd like to let you, our community, know how grateful we are that we have you! You have given our baby so much love and have filled us, as developers with even more energy to create an incredible game! [/p][p][/p][p]Today, we're writing to let our community know that now is a crucial time for us! [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/670138376/spell-candle"][b]The Spell Candle Kickstarter[/b][/url] has just launched and is aiming to raise 25 000€ to fund the full development of the game. We would love to have your support on this matter! We've already reached [b]32% funding in 24 hours[/b] and [b]the rewards[/b] ([i]you can see some of them if you scroll down on this post[/i]) are pretty spectacular![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170569/aca1f6c78aa195ca8eb93a112547c574c9ad34af.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Early Birds[/b] [b]Rewards[/b] are now live with [u]special discounts[/u] and add-ons such as the physical artbook, chesticle T-shirts, a Tote Bag, and a Kiss-the-chef Apron are available for purchase alongside several reward tiers! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170569/d137ab0e314346be211374bcad60446fbc2ec4d0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]The Stretch Goals include[/b] Partial Voice Acting, [b]A Muscle Mommy Female Love Interest[/b] and a [i]le gasp[/i] fully voice-acted [b]NSFW DLC[/b]?! Our writer has read enough booktok for this.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170569/f089adff9a3fa277c6a121c21fe3c45def69c266.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Thank you so much for taking the time to play our demo and support our [b][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/670138376/spell-candle"]Kickstarter[/url][/b]! Please share it with any friends you think would be interested. It would mean the world to us to reach the 25 000€ and create a world that you can all enjoy and make your own. [/p][p][/p][p]Once again, we are humbled by all of the love and affection you've given our baby so far![/p][p][/p][p]Kindest regards,[/p][p]The Bottled Monster Ink. Team[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170569/afd27519c59a1b0801ac7833510caef703d9183e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]
